# 75176 - Differential bus transceiver (RS-422/RS-485), 3-state driver and receiver

Package DIP-8 · family 75 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75176.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75176.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | R | output |  | three-state | enabled by RE; receiver logic output |
| 2 | /RE | enable | low |  | controls pins 1; when not enabled: float; receiver enable, active low |
| 3 | DE | enable | high |  | controls pins 6, 7; when not enabled: float; driver enable, active high |
| 4 | D | input |  |  | driver logic input |
| 5 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 6 | A | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin, non-inverting: driver output and receiver input |
| 7 | B | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin, inverting: driver output and receiver input |
| 8 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | A = D | while DE is high, A follows D; while DE is low it floats. |
| 7 | B = NOT D | while DE is high, B is the opposite of D; while DE is low it floats. |
| 1 | R = APOS | while /RE is low: R is high when A - B &gt;= +0.2 V, low when A - B &lt;= -0.2 V, unknown in between and with the inputs open; R floats while /RE is high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 60 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -60 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Driver: IOH -60 mA, IOL 60 mA. Receiver output: IOH -0.4 mA, IOL 8 mA. Receiver input hysteresis 50 mV typ, input resistance 12 kohm min. Bus pins -7 V to +12 V. Supply 4.75-5.25 V (pages 4, 6). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D | A | PLH | 15 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 54 ohm; differential output delay, given once for both directions |
| D | A | PHL | 15 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 54 ohm; differential output delay, given once for both directions |
| D | A | rise | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 54 ohm; differential output transition time |
| DE | A | PZH | 85 | 120 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 110 ohm |
| DE | A | PZL | 40 | 60 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 110 ohm |
| DE | A | PHZ | 150 | 250 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 110 ohm |
| DE | A | PLZ | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 110 ohm |
| A | R | PLH | 21 | 35 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, VID 0 to 3 V |
| A | R | PHL | 23 | 35 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, VID 0 to 3 V |
| /RE | R | PZH | 10 | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF |
| /RE | R | PZL | 12 | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF |
| /RE | R | PHZ | 20 | 35 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF |
| /RE | R | PLZ | 17 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF |

## Not known

- The driver function table (section 6.3.1, page 12) was not read; the driver direction (A = D, B = NOT D) is read from the simplified schematic on page 1 (open bubble on the B output) and the note on page 4 that A is the non-inverting terminal.

## Notes

The card drawing names the pins EB (pin 3, drive enable), D (pin 4), EY~ (pin 2, receive enable), Y (pin 1), B and B~ (pins 6, 7). The datasheet gives no minimum delays.

## Sources

- [TI SN65176B/SN75176B datasheet SLLS101I (July 1985, revised August 2025)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn75176b.pdf) - 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 13; SN75176B
